The main takeaway from our work is that
the extracted DFAs can generalize well on unseen data, even though they are extracted from a trained recurrent neural network.
, when the number of training strings is sufficiently large, the extracted DFAs generalize better than the trained network.
the extraction of rules from trained neural networks can be a useful tool for understanding the behavior of recurrent neural networks and for extracting symbolic knowledge from them.
